description: SaveCapTableImport replaces the formation's shareholders with the imported, founder-edited list. A request whose shareholders carry ssn_last4 is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT and writes nothing — the existing roster is left exactly as it was: those four digits are recorded only by SetShareholderTaxIdentifier, after the whole identifier has reached the secret store. Accepting them here would report a saved number that nothing holds. Refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION once the formation is filed, except for reviewer-or-higher staff calling directly (not delegated).
name: formation_save_cap_table_import
title: Save Cap Table Import
